capabilities: Render product titles as spec or comparison tables
Total ammo purchase logs with rounds and cost per round
Normalize caliber names in a text selection
Optionally link calibers to price pages on gunsnprices.com
extras: Works fully offline with no network requests; requires iOS 16.4+ on iOS. Caliber linking to gunsnprices.com is off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn free-form product titles into structured comparison tables or to total ammo purchases with a cost per round.

relations.evidence: It runs the gunsnprices title parser, the one behind the price comparison site

summary: Parses store-style gun and ammo listing titles into spec tables, totals ammo purchase logs with cost per round, and normalizes caliber names.
